rules.instruction: Use a white canvas, charcoal primary text, muted gray borders, and a single blue accent. Keep identical color roles across screens.
Use one neutral sans-serif family with regular body text and semibold headings. Keep the same heading/body/caption hierarchy.
Reuse button, input, icon, corner-radius, and spacing treatments. Keep the same sidebar width and navigation treatment across screens.
Use a desktop app layout with a left sidebar, page title, aligned content edges, and restrained density. Avoid nested card stacks, heavy shadows, and decorative gradients.
Use short readable UI labels and clear hierarchy. No invented brand logo or watermarks. This is a visual concept, not a claim of functional code.

Verify the requested subject and this job's specific content or variation are actually present. Matching the style alone is insufficient; reject the result if it misses the requested content, screen, product, or change.

concepts: Show the analytics dashboard, with a left sidebar, summary metrics, a simple chart, and a recent activity table.
Show the account settings page, with the same sidebar and components, profile fields, and notification preferences.
